label: Standing height
note: Program PM SOURCE concept, not LOINC 3036277 (the standard concept silently pools ~395k EHR heights). Includes remote self-report; separable via measurement_ext.src_id.

label: Body weight
note: Same program-measurement family as height. AoU ships no reliable BMI concept; derive it from height+weight taken at the SAME visit or you pair tallest-ever with heaviest-ever.

label: Systolic blood pressure
note: AoU takes BP three times per visit; the codebook summary is the MEAN OF THE 2ND AND 3RD readings. These are those two concepts; the discarded 1st reading is 903109.

label: LDL cholesterol
note: EHR lab: many values per person over years, so a real analysis must choose an aggregate and restrict units (mg/dL = unit concept 8840; many rows carry no unit at all). Direct and calculated LDL are separate concepts.

label: HDL cholesterol
note: Same EHR-lab caveats as LDL. LOINC 2085-9.

label: Highest grade completed
note: The Basics survey (near-full coverage). In Controlled Tier expect ~8 substantive answer rows; a 2-row distribution means you got the Registered-Tier bucketed version.

label: Self-rated general health
note: Overall Health survey. Join answers on value_source_concept_id, NOT value_as_concept_id (frequently 0 for survey concepts; the join half-empties with no error).

label: Smoked 100+ cigarettes (lifetime)
note: Gateway question for the smoking branch: every detail item (cigarettes/day, age started) is asked only of people who pass this gate, so non-branched participants are structural zeros there, not missing.

label: Type 2 diabetes (EHR cases)
note: Cases live under TWO disjoint concept branches; a UNION is required. Counting descendants of only one branch undercounts silently. Concept IDs are claims until you check the resolved names this script prints.
